what: When a paragraph’s top reaches the screen center, the paragraph switches on in .6s (opacity 0→1), then a highlighter is painted behind the emphasized word, starting .4s later from the left over .6s, and stays. One time only — if paragraphs are stacked in a pinned slot, one paragraph switches on per scroll

options.start: ScrollTrigger start position, default top center
options.--fx-mark-h: Highlighter height (from the bottom of the text line), default 100%
options.look: mark: No paragraph reveal, visible from the start with only a highlighter marker painted — a spot where text is read first, like a speech-bubble testimonial

use: What the guest draws Together We shape it into form.

from.where: index.html fixed about cell .tg-intro__p — original top.js data-animation=fadeIn(start top center, is-active), top.css opacity .6s · emphasized word background-size .6s ease .4s
index.html .sw-speech — when the speech bubble is 20% visible (at 90% of the screen) the yellow underlay is painted in over .75s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) (look: mark, start: 20% 90%)
